text:
rachel: FYI incoming pen test confirmed Tue 2025-07-01 09:00 PDT. Need a concise evidence kit: RBAC snapshot, KMS temporary access, audit export, and a remediation+retest tracker. Who can take ownership?

marc: I9ll do RBAC snapshot and a small csv of broad permissions. Will run the dump and post SHA. ETA: Fri EOD.

jin: I'll own KMS plan. Proposal: create alias/pt-temp, grant kms:Decrypt to PTAssessorRole for a 7-day window and restrict by assessor IP range. I'll draft key policy and role trust.

rachel: For audit logs, we need CloudTrail export showing KMS:Decrypt and s3:PutObject/GetObject during the window. Ops retention policy is 90d hot + 365d cold; include that in the evidence readme.

marc: RBAC dump command I'll use:
```bash
./bin/rbac_export --env=prod --out=rbac-1807654321.json && sha256sum rbac-1807654321.json
```
Will upload to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1807654321/ and include a README.

jin: Presign flow: assessors get presigned PUT urls into s3://redwood-pt-uploads/1807654321/ for 4h. After window, a lambda moves objects to evidence bucket with quarantine tag. Example presign:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-uploads/1807654321/extra.pdf --expires-in 14400
```

infra-bot: Reminder: staging dry-run for PT workflow scheduled 2025-06-28T00:00Z. See /ops/playbooks/pt-dryrun.md

rachel: Remediation tracker: simple CSV cols: vuln_id, component, severity, fix_pr, deploy_sha, verify_steps, status, planned_retest_date. I'll maintain it and schedule retest slots within 10 business days after deploy.

marc: acked. Will post RBAC snapshot + sha once uploaded.

jin: acked. PR for key policy + role coming today.

rachel: Great. If any blockers, ping #eng-oncall. I'll close thread after artifacts are uploaded.
